contract.shared: Canonical, GramJS/teleproto facades and bound file replies/edits use the same caption conversion and selected RPC boundary.
contract.captions: Scalar captions belong to the first album item; arrays follow item order. Single files accept the first caption in an array. All used album captions validate before any source is consumed.
contract.precedence: FormattedText owns its entities. Explicit formattingEntities/entities skip parsing; top-level entities belong only to the first album item. Per-item caption, mode and entities override inherited settings.
contract.ordering: Validate captions and resolve mention users and the destination before upload. Preserve cancellation and typed lookup/submission failures without backend replay.
contract.media: Reuse existing shared schema casts for InputMedia, Photo, Document, MessageMedia, InputPhoto, InputDocument and uploaded InputFile values. Copy reusable media byte references before handing them to a backend.

differences: Pinned SDK albums ignore formattingEntities; owned albums retain an explicit first-caption/per-item contract.
Owned album item options and FormattedText are extensions; pinned SDKs accept raw file arrays and caption strings.

Pinned GramJS layer 181 changes nested media/reply constructor IDs as well as method IDs. Complete bytes match when each request is serialized through the same SDK; current native bytes match teleproto and a separate current-schema translation of GramJS requests.
Validation happens before upload consumption, including invalid later captions and replacement-file edits. Pinned edit helpers prepare files before parsing text.
Top-level randomId never becomes a shared album item ID; per-item IDs remain independent.
This verifies explicit parser settings. SDK default Markdown selection and complete media-option parity remain separate unfinished criteria.
